title: impl-scaffold: shadow-cljs + re-frame2 + Reagent boot
description:
Scaffold the project so 'npx shadow-cljs watch app' boots a Reagent view via re-frame2 at localhost:8080.

SCOPE (this bead only):
- shadow-cljs.edn with :app (browser, dev) and :test (browser-test or node) builds
- deps.edn pulling re-frame2 (git dep from day8/re-frame2; pick a commit SHA and record it)
- package.json with shadow-cljs dev-dep
- public/index.html boilerplate
- src/reframe_2048_2/core.cljs — minimal mount of a placeholder Reagent view inside a single re-frame2 frame named :game
- .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs shadow-cljs compile on push
- README.md section with build/run/test commands
- .gitignore additions: node_modules/, .shadow-cljs/, target/, out/

OUT OF SCOPE: game mechanics, app-db schema, events, subs, views beyond a placeholder, persistence, animation, tests beyond a smoke test.

ACCEPTANCE:
- 'npm install && npx shadow-cljs watch app' starts; browser at localhost:8080 shows 'Hello, 2048-reframe-2'
- 'npx shadow-cljs compile test' succeeds (even with zero specs)
- CI workflow passes on push
- PR opened against main; mayor reviews and merges

SOURCES: /ai/specs/2048-reframe-2.md §10 (build), §4 (re-frame2 grammar), §4.3 (single :game frame). re-frame2 docs at github.com/day8/re-frame2 spec/.

title: Audit /ai/specs/2048-reframe-2.md v0.2 against re-frame2 SA-2..7 and canonical 2048

title: Draft v0 spec for 2048 in re-frame2
description: Author /ai/specs/2048-reframe-2.md following IETF-RFC structure and RFC 2119 keywords for normative passages. Sources: github.com/day8/re-frame2 (spec-first framework), github.com/gabrielecirulli/2048 (canonical mechanics). Iterate via operator interview + a dispatched background audit per CLAUDE.md Mayor Method.
notes:
v0 draft committed to /ai/specs/2048-reframe-2.md — 10 open questions surfaced for operator interview before v1.
v0.3 landed: folded D-01..D-05 from v0.2 audit. D-01 swapped splitmix64 → xorshift32 (fits CLJS Int32, no precision loss). D-02 loosened Cell schema. D-03 rewrote value-choice prose as integer mod-100<90 (exact P(2)=0.9). D-04 added ignored-events clause. D-05 collapsed :game/new synthetic double-transition. D-06..D-09 + 10 NITs deferred per operator no-pedantry redirect. Dispatch-ready for impl agents.

title: v1+ follow-up: in-progress game persistence (NG8)
description: Persist the in-progress game across reloads per §7.2 reservation. Key reframe-2048-2/game-v1. Adds StorageBlob-Game schema. On boot, hydrate :game.tiles, :score, :next-id, :rng-seed; skip if storage absent/corrupt. Spec amendment required (NG8 lifted, §7.2 rewritten).

title: v1+ follow-up: touch / swipe input (NG7)
description: Add touch input per §6.2 of the spec. Swipe gestures → :game/move with the same Direction payload. Add Anim* and Sub-AnimationBusy considerations for mid-swipe cancellation. Tests: swipe-vs-scroll disambiguation, swipe-threshold tuning. Spec amendment required (NG7 lifted, §6.2 rewritten).

title: v1+ follow-up: vim-key bindings h/j/k/l (NG9)
description: Add canonical 2048 vim keybindings to §6.1: h=left, j=down, k=up, l=right (and uppercase). Spec amendment required (NG9 lifted).
